ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 92% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 8% high-intensity (white/beige) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region covering the central and lower fluke area. High-contrast beige/white circular clusters (barnacle colonies) mapped to the extreme distal left and right tips. Approximately 12-15 discrete white-ring pixel clusters (scars) mapped across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate internal angle of 48 degrees; notch depth is clearly defined at the convergence of the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular margin with frequent peaks and valleys; serration amplitude is significantly higher on the left lobe's upper margin compared to the right lobe's higher-frequency, lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory sweeping from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in jagged, high-contrast extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast pixel groups located on the distal tips. Multiple isolated circular white-outline markers (approximately 2-5 pixels in diameter) scattered on the black interior surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast grey linear pixel disruptions detected horizontally across the lower-left quadrant of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular ring-shaped scars distributed across the black skin; dense living barnacle colonies localized at both distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips of the trailing edge exhibit a highly irregular, bulbous silhouette due to heavy localized barnacle colonization.
